title: M8 raw input NoLogical and actual encoded dimension

spec.name: M8.RawParameters.raw_anchor
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M8.PhysicalBridge.Recipe N), 0 < w → M8.PhysicalBridge.Valid w c → ∃ g : M7.Action.Record N, M8.PhysicalBridge.Anchored (M7.Action.act g c)
spec.guidance:
Close the raw unanchored M8 NoLogical and physical dimension interfaces, without supplied optimizer correctness. raw_anchor: positive cards give a∈c.1,b∈c.2; choose M8.Anchor.record false 1 a b and use accepted Anchor.anchored with Eligible. raw_noLogical: choose actual g via raw_anchor. Pointwise_optimizer provides AnswerCorrect for actual transformed arrays; its first two clauses show actual solve=none iff actual quantumDistance=none. PhysicalBridge.noLogical and Transport.distance_invariant transfer exactly original full gcd=1. For LX empty use M6.ActualCSS.common_quantum_distance N indicatorA indicatorB and M6.Pinned.distance_spec, unfolding Final quantumDistance/BX/CX/BZ/CZ and Domain.coefficients_indicator to match Transport.LX. encoded_dimension: M6.ActualCounts.encoded_dimension N literalpolys needs degree<N, obtained from Polynomial.degree_le_natDegree plus Supports.degree_lt; this existing theorem is all-order and needs no anchored premise. Unfold Final.encodedQubits, ActualCounts.f and PhysicalBridge.signature/RecipeSignature.signature/Domain.signature to identify exact full gcd. Do not add assumptions. Return tactic lines only.
import M8PhysicalBridgeAccepted
import M8AnchorAccepted
namespace M8.RawParameters
end M8.RawParameters
